title: Identity-Locked Streetwear Drop
description: A nine-image identity-locked portrait series for Streetwear Drop Campaign Portraits, built from one reference portrait and eight dependent variations.
creative_direction: Portrait backlog lock: image 01 establishes the exact person for Streetwear Drop Campaign Portraits; images 02-09 all depend on that reference and may vary only lighting, scene, wardrobe, pose, emotion, or grooming while preserving the same face, hair base, and body proportions.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-drop-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-hoodie-hero, 03-varsity-layer, 04-cap-and-denim, 05-detail-crop-hands, 06-duo-cast-street-step, 07-poster-cover, 08-night-rimlight-portrait, 09-campaign-contact-sheet. Queue may run 02-09 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
